[9PM] #IyanaOworo #TrafficUpdate 

Third Mainland Bridge is clear in both directions. 
Smooth traffic flow on Iyana Oworo to Gbagada, Bariga axis, and towards Muritala and UNILAG Gate. 
Officers are on ground managing traffic, no impediments reported.
